title: Crypto RL Trading System - ByBit Perpetuals
description:
## Overview

Transform the existing Forex PPO trading system into a crypto perpetual futures trading system using ByBit exchange. The system will learn trading strategies based on the high win-rate SR Swing Strategy.

## Target Pairs
- SUI/USDT Perpetual
- SOL/USDT Perpetual  
- LINK/USDT Perpetual
- BNB/USDT Perpetual

## Success Criteria
- [ ] CCXT data pipeline fetches all 4 pairs from ByBit
- [ ] Dynamic fee fetching from exchange API
- [ ] Feature extractor implements SR Swing indicators
- [ ] PPO agent trains on crypto data without errors
- [ ] Backtest shows positive expectancy
- [ ] Paper trading validates real-time signals

## Background
Existing codebase trades EUR/USD with simple indicators. User wants to migrate to crypto perpetuals with sophisticated SR Swing Strategy (pivots, HMA, Kalman filters, MTF analysis).

## Scope
**In Scope:**
- CCXT integration for ByBit perpetuals
- Dynamic fee model via exchange API
- Strategy indicator migration (pivots, HMA, Kalman, etc.)
- Multi-timeframe feature engineering
- PPO training pipeline adaptation
- Backtesting and validation framework

**Out of Scope:**
- Live trading execution (paper trading only for now)
- Grid/martingale strategies
- Multi-account management

### Feature Layer (Phase 2)

- Multi-timeframe: LTF (5m/15m) + HTF (1h/4h)

### RL Layer (Phase 3)
- : Gymnasium environment for perpetuals
- : PPO training pipeline
- Dynamic fee model, 24/7 trading, percentage-based SL/TP

### Validation Layer (Phase 5)
- Walk-forward validation
- Cross-pair robustness testing
- Monte Carlo analysis

title: Fix reward function to prevent early exit gaming
description:
Root cause analysis revealed the model learns to close trades early instead of letting SL/TP work. Key findings:

**Training Results:**
- Win rate: 44.29% (target >55%)
- Profit factor: 0.719 (target >1.5)  
- Final equity: 5.96% (lost 94%)
- Max drawdown: 94.2%

**Behavioral Analysis:**
- 71.5% of trades closed via FLIP or MANUAL_CLOSE (not SL/TP)
- Only 7.3% of trades hit TP (12/165)
- TIGHT positions worse: 38.2% WR vs 51.3% for normal

**Root Causes:**
1. Unrealized PnL shaping rewards ANY delta, making small exits attractive
2. CLOSE action has no penalty - agent can lock in tiny gains risk-free
3. TIGHT actions (1%/1.5% SL/TP) trigger on noise
4. No incentive to let winners run to TP

Child tickets will address each issue individually.
close_reason: All child fixes implemented and verified: uqj (asymmetric shaping), 9yk (premature exit penalty), 2kf (remove TIGHT actions). Ready for retrain.

title: Add penalty for premature trade exits
description:
Problem: CLOSE action has no cost, making it attractive to exit with tiny profits.

Current behavior:
- Open at 100, close at 100.05 = +0.05% - 0.11% fees = -0.06% 
- Model does this repeatedly, grinding down equity

Proposed fix: Add exit penalty when closing before SL/TP zone

```python
# In _calculate_exit_reward():
if reason in ['MANUAL_CLOSE', 'FLIP']:
    # Penalty if we didn't reach near TP
    tp_distance = abs(self.tp_price - self.entry_price) / self.entry_price
    current_distance = abs(exit_price - self.entry_price) / self.entry_price
    achieved_pct = current_distance / tp_distance if tp_distance > 0 else 0
    
    if achieved_pct < 0.5:  # Closed before reaching 50% of TP
        premature_penalty = 0.005 * self.reward_scale  # -0.5% penalty
        reward -= premature_penalty
```

Location: trading_env.py _calculate_exit_reward()
close_reason: Added premature exit penalty in _close_position(). For MANUAL_CLOSE/FLIP exits before 50% of TP: penalty = 0.5% * (1 - achieved_pct * 2). Verified working with test.

title: Make unrealized PnL shaping asymmetric
description:
Current: unrealized_pnl_weight=0.1 applies to ALL delta (winners and losers equally).

Problem: Rewards closing winning trades early to 'lock in' the shaping reward.

Fix: Make shaping asymmetric:
- PENALIZE holding losing positions (negative delta on losers)
- Do NOT reward holding winners (let actual exit reward do that)
- Or: Only apply shaping when unrealized is negative

Location: trading_env.py lines 431-434

```python
# Current (bad):
delta_unrealized = unrealized - self._prev_unrealized_pnl
reward += delta_unrealized * self.unrealized_pnl_weight * self.reward_scale

# Proposed (asymmetric):
delta_unrealized = unrealized - self._prev_unrealized_pnl
if unrealized < 0:  # Only penalize holding losers
    reward += delta_unrealized * self.unrealized_pnl_weight * self.reward_scale
```
close_reason: Implemented asymmetric shaping: only penalize holding losers (unrealized < 0), don't reward holding winners. Verified: winning positions get reward=0.0000.
